obligations.definition: The full BIMBranchPredictorBank root and source-supplied data_2048x8 dependency are in scope. There are four prediction slots, no top parameters and no backpressure. Every native input bit pattern is legal. All state updates on rising edges; reset is synchronous active high. Uninitialized values remain unspecified until captured or written; do not assign invented numeric startup values. Reset controls the sweep and bypass replacement selector only; request, update and output pipeline state continue capturing through reset.

obligations.definition: A reset edge sets sweeping one and sweep index zero. Reset itself does not directly clear memory or bypass records; writes use the pre-edge controls, including on reset edges.

obligations.definition: Training uses one complete four-counter byte from a matching bypass record before using supplied meta bits7:0. Record tags compare the full delayed pc[14:4], independently of physical-row aliasing; record0 has priority if both match. Matches are disabled while sweeping. A valid nonsuppressed update with any selected slot updates all four counter values of the matching record, including unselected slots. On a miss it replaces the record selected by a one-bit round-robin selector, writes that full tag and all four computed counters, and flips the selector unless reset is active. Reset sets the selector zero but preserves existing tags/data. Even during sweep eligible updates can populate bypass records, although memory writes use twos. The physical memory write mask alone restricts which selected lanes are written.
